options.label: Via Santa Rita and Los Osos
options.note: Back roads over the 46 West ridge and down Santa Rita, then Los Osos Valley Road to the coast. Steeper: the worst half mile averages 9.9%, and about a mile of the day sits at 9% or more. Skips Atascadero and San Luis Obispo.

options.label: Highway 41
options.note: Same coastal half, but crosses on Highway 41 via Atascadero. Steadier — the worst half mile averages 7.5% — at the cost of ~19 mi on highways.
